errors.text_span: 图表中有两组柱状图，每组代表一个类别
errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart with 10 groups on the x-axis (labeled 1 to 10) and two series represented by different colors. The description incorrectly states there are two groups of bars and that each group represents a category, which misrepresents the structure of the chart.

The description mentions the light and dark grey bars but fails to connect them to their respective meanings as defined in the legend: '30个模型结果的均值' (Average of 30 model results) for the light grey bars and '30个模型的投票结果' (Voting result of 30 models) for the dark grey bars.

errors.text_span: 深灰色柱状图普遍高于浅灰色柱状图
errors.evidence: The dark grey bar is higher than the light grey bar in all 10 instances shown in the chart. The term '普遍高于' (generally higher) is an understatement and less precise than stating it is always higher.
